subject: Clearwell Health — erase request: prompts/outputs/logs (EU region) / attestation pathway
messages:
From: Sara McKinley <sara.mckinley@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:14:00Z
Subject: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs (EU) — scope and evidence

Hi Connor,

We need Redwood to execute a purge for Clearwell Health covering: user prompts, generated outputs, API request logs, KV cache entries and any derived embeddings that can be attributed to our account in the eu-west-1 region. This is an internal compliance requirement – the security committee needs a clear runbook, estimated timeline, and an evidence bundle we can present.

Questions:
- Can you confirm exactly what artifacts will be removed vs retained (e.g., aggregated metrics, anonymized telemetry)?
- What's your standard timeline and SLA for a full purge in EU?
- What proof do you supply (signed manifest, logs, timestamps)?

Prefer a window next week (we can be flexible on downtime; aim for evening CET).

Thanks,
Sara
Sara McKinley
Head of Security Operations
Clearwell Health

Attachments: none

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara McKinley <sara.mckinley@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs (EU) — scope and evidence

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear ask. I looped in Privacy Ops (Marissa), Backend (PrIyom) and Security (Hannah) so we can map the technical steps and the attestation artifacts. High level plan below; we'll follow up with exact timestamps after confirming a maintenance window.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Intake ticket and legal acknowledgement (we'll create ERASE-4721).
2) Pre-run snapshot for audit (read-only snapshot held for 72 hours and then deleted per your instruction).
3) Sequential purge: prompts/outputs -> embeddings -> KV cache -> request logs -> derived telemetry sweep. We purge by account id and region.
4) Post-run evidence: a signed CSV manifest with object ids removed, workflow log (sha256-signed), and a short attestation letter.
5) DocuSign attestation (optional) we can initiate for your audit package.

Estimated timeline: 4–8 hours depending on active traffic and shard count. For eu-west-1 we expect ~6 hours typical. If you need expedited (<48 hours) we can prioritize but will require SLA exception approval.

I've attached our internal erasure runbook (redwood_erasure_runbook_v1.2.pdf) for the sequence and fallback steps. PrIyom — can you confirm the shard counts and a rough estimate for Clearwell? Marissa — any compliance constraints we should note? Hannah — any security/follow-up evidence you want added?

I'll follow up with a proposed evening CET slot once we get confirmation.

Best,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0199

Attachments: redwood_erasure_runbook_v1.2.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara McKinley <sara.mckinley@clearwellhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs (EU) — compliance notes

Connor / team / Sara — quick compliance notes to bake into the plan:
- We treat "derived telemetry" (aggregated metrics with no user identifiers) as retained by default; if Clearwell requires full removal, we need an explicit instruction.
- Evidence set we provide: erasure_manifest (CSV with object ids + SHA256), workflow_log (chronological commands and process ids), and a signed attestation PDF.
- Chain-of-custody: we'll produce a CSV that maps the API object identifiers to purge job ids and timestamps. That CSV will be included in the evidence bundle.
- Retention of audit logs: Redwood retains low-level audit traces for 90 days by default; if you require extension/shortening, we can arrange a contractual amendment.

I've attached a blank erasure_manifest_template.csv you can preview to understand the fields we'll deliver.

Marissa Cole
Privacy Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: erasure_manifest_template.csv (CSV)

From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara McKinley <sara.mckinley@clearwellhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T11:16:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs (EU) — technical sequence and timing

Folks — technical detail: for Clearwell in eu-west-1 the account spans 18 inference shards and 4 KV partitions. Execution plan we will run:
- Step 1 (00:00–01:00): Quiesce write traffic for the account (route to dedicated fallback or reject new requests).
- Step 2 (01:00–03:30): Run object-level purge for prompt/output artifacts using job-runner v2.4 (parallelized across shards).
- Step 3 (03:30–04:15): Invalidate and zero KV partitions (atomic rotate+wipe).
- Step 4 (04:15–05:00): Sweep embeddings index and delete derived vectors (this touches vector store and per-account indices).
- Step 5 (05:00–06:00): Purge request logs (rolling delete to avoid DB locks) and run verification queries.

Fallback: if live traffic prevents quiescing, we'll route requests to a compatible model variant with strict sampling and deny writeback.

I'll capture command outputs and job ids in the workflow_log file. Expect total ~5.5 hours on the hardware profile assigned.

PrIyom Das
Backend Lead, Inference Operations

Attachments: none

From: Sara McKinley <sara.mckinley@clearwellhealth.com>

Date: 2026-09-12T07:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs (EU) — confirmation of scope

Thanks — we confirm full removal including derived embeddings and request logs. Please schedule the run on 2026-09-16 starting 18:00 CET.

A few quick asks for the evidence bundle:
- Exact UTC timestamps for the start and finish of each step.
- CSV with object ids + SHA256 + purge job id.
- Workflow log with command outputs.
- DocuSign attestation we can include in our internal packet for the security committee.

Legal will confirm the DocuSign signatories; for now they request Connor to initiate the attestation.

Sara

Attachments: none
